flora: Cycads (stout trunks, crown of stiff fronds)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rough, diamond-patterned trunk textures; thick, leathery fronds with a protective, waxy sheen; chunky central cones with stylized details.

visual_logic.composition: A centered 'hero' shot of a mature Cycad nestled between two large, mossy rocks. Its fronds fan out to fill the mid-ground.
visual_logic.ground: Saturated forest floor with layers of dark organic matter and occasional clusters of mossy shale.
visual_logic.lighting: Vibrant cinematic light with high-key highlights on the waxy surfaces of the upper fronds.
